title: Phone call to Bobby Ray Inman about Puharich and Bob Beck

tellings.quote: And he was pretty nice, but I just straight up was like, "Hey, have you ever heard, you know, the name Andrija Puharich? Do you know Bob Beck?" That cuz those were the two working at that time um with the space kids, and he was like, "No, I've never never heard the name."

plain: A researcher named Greg Malatzi says he phoned a man named Bobby Ray Inman and asked him straight out whether he knew Andrija Puharich or Bob Beck, the two men he says were working in that era with the "space kids," children said to have psychic gifts. Malatzi tells Michels that Inman was pleasant but answered, "No, I've never heard the name."
